gating.rule: CHARTER section 3, USER DECISION at the step-4 stop (narrow stand-up to tall tables): the K3 line (tables pooled over the 6 gated cells per env seed) and the R_h floor (per gated top pooled over the gated poses) read the gated cells only; the reported cells (the 18-in table, every rod_min cell, every ground cell) are run and read, never gated

stood_definition: K3 STOOD iff, over the last 3.0 s (150 control steps): (1) the ROOT risen >= 0.10 m above its realised spawn root z on >= 95 % of the steps (>= 143 of 150; the belly centre's rise -- a tilted chassis' lowest corner is not used, it drops ~1 cm per degree of tilt); (2) >= 4 of 6 footpads loaded on the floor (net contact >= 20 N, footpad centre z <= 0.15 m) on >= 95 % of the steps (>= 143 of 150); (3) |h_meas - h_cmd| <= 0.04 m on >= 95 % of the steps (h_meas = root z - mean terrain z under the six feet; h_cmd = the env's command); and over the whole episode (4) no fall: tilt <= 0.5 rad, no ARMED hip contact (any hip link > 500 N; armed from step 0 on a table, on the ground from the first step the belly has risen >= 0.10 m above its spawn height -- PLAN H5), on a table never more than 0.05 m below the table-top plane; (5) no termination (time-out only, 2 s past the episode). Reported: 5-down / 6-down STOOD, window shares, the envs that fail ONLY the rise clause (``rise_only_fail``), the lowest-corner rise, |h - h_cmd| median / p90 / max, limiter arrival, first time within 2 cm, lift-off, standing-since, falls by cause, pre-arm hip contacts, HOMED (every cam <= 0.10 rad over the last 5 s), settled, cams homed on the final step. The hip-contact ARMING (4) keeps the lowest-corner rise (the trainer's re-arm rule, sh_starts.post_physics).
